<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ProductDevelopment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/product-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductDevelopment" name="Product Idea to Prototype Decision" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ProductIdea" name="Product idea identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyIdea" name="Identify idea for new or improved product">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Research" name="Conduct initial research and feasibility study">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftConcepts" name="Draft design concepts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select promising design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype using available materials and resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestEntry_Merge" name="Testing entry">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestPrototype" name="Test prototype for functionality, safety and market potential">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect feedback from testing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementNeeded_Split" name="Refinement needed?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Outcome_Split" name="Prototype approved or discarded?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Prototype approved for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Discarded" name="Prototype discarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_ProductIdea" targetRef="Task_IdentifyIdea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyIdea" targetRef="Task_Research"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_Research" targetRef="Task_DraftConcepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_DraftConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestEntry_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_TestEntry_Merge" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_TestPrototype" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded_Split" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestEntry_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_Discarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
